statement: The Epoch Capabilities Index gain in 2027 is < 50% of its 2025 gain (Epoch AI; 2028-01)
status_at_phase_end: Data gap. The Epoch Capabilities Index did not exist; the main ML-trends analysis of the time tracked training compute (doubling ~every 6 months since ~2010), not a capability index. The nearest available capability measures were broad benchmark suites launched in 2022. Within the window a major conversational model launch (2022-11-30) signalled continued capability progress rather than a plateau, but no index-based gain can be computed.

items.summary: The main published ML-trends analysis of the time tracked training compute (training compute doubling roughly every 6 months in the deep-learning era, with a separate large-scale trend from late 2015) but no capabilities index; the indicator metric did not exist at phase end.
items.detail: Sevilla, Heim, Ho, Besiroglu, Hobbhahn, Villalobos, 'Compute Trends Across Three Eras of Machine Learning', arXiv:2202.05924 (v1 2022-02-11, v2 2022-03-09; verified via web_extract this run). No capabilities index existed as of 2022.

items.summary: The nearest capability-measurement effort at the time was a newly launched holistic benchmark covering 30 prominent language models across many scenarios and metrics - a cross-sectional snapshot, not a time series of frontier gains.
items.detail: Stanford CRFM, 'Language Models are Changing AI: The Need for Holistic Evaluation' (HELM), 2022-11-17 (verified via web_extract this run).

items.summary: A large collaborative benchmark suite for quantifying and extrapolating language-model capabilities was released in mid-2022, another sign that capability measurement was benchmark-based rather than index-based.
items.detail: 'Beyond the Imitation Game' (BIG-bench), arXiv:2206.04615, v1 2022-06-09 (verified via web_extract this run; the abstract page shown is v3 of 2023-06-12, so only the title, date and repo are used).

items.summary: In the window a Bloc A developer launched a dialogue model trained with reinforcement learning from human feedback on a newer model series, a qualitative capability step rather than a plateau signal; no index measured the gain.
items.detail: OpenAI, 'Introducing ChatGPT', 2022-11-30 (verified via web_extract this run): fine-tuned from a GPT-3.5 series model that finished training in early 2022; trained with RLHF; listed limitations include plausible-sounding but incorrect answers.
